summary_1line: Bharata moves to Nandigrama, placing Rama’s sandals as the true symbol of kingship while he rules Ayodhya as a devoted regent awaiting Rama’s return.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata walks in procession to Nandigrama carrying Rama’s golden-decorated sandals on his head while priests, soldiers, and citizens follow.
Before elders and citizens, Bharata raises Rama’s sandals reverently, declaring them the true rulers of Ayodhya.
